mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the colon to its blood vessels showed where recovered water and microbial products go, including that lining cells use some products themselves.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final connection was mostly an expected assembly step; it added less explanation than the exchange itself.

surprise.text: I didn't expect bacteria breaking down leftover fibre to produce gas as well as small molecules.

arbitrary.text: The lining couldn't connect to the blood vessels until it was paired with the colon contents. That order wasn't clear to me, although the compatibility hint made the next step possible.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing how the microbes, lining and blood work together made me curious about other body connections, even though the final assembly was predictable.
